items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: The app starts and Home draws correctly
items.do: Start PokeBank NX handheld. Look at Home: game cards, artwork, text, footer. Then dock the Switch and look again.
items.expect: No crash or black screen. Nothing clipped, overlapping or missing in handheld or docked mode.

items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: Your real saves are found
items.game: Every Gen I-V game you have saves for
items.do: Do NOT delete anything in sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX first. Scroll through the game cards.
items.expect: Each game you have a save for has a card. Comment with any game whose save is on the card but not found, and where the file is (emulator and folder).

items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: Save Instances opens a real save (the Round 15 failure)
items.game: Pokémon Yellow or Blue (RetroArch, Gambatte folder)
items.do: Press A. If Save Instances appears, pick your save with A.
items.expect: The game opens. If Home later says 'Save choices are kept until PokeBank NX closes; they could not be stored [...]', copy the text in [...] into the comment.

items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: The choice survives closing the app
items.game: The game from H03, plus one Gen III, one Gen IV and one Gen V game
items.do: Open each game once (pick its save if asked). Close PokeBank NX completely. Start it again and press A on each.
items.expect: Every one opens directly, with no chooser.

items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: Touch works on the real screen
items.do: Tap a Pokémon. Tap an empty slot. Drag across four Pokémon and lift. Tap outside a pop-up.
items.expect: Taps hit what you touched (not a neighbour). The drag selects the group. A tap outside closes the pop-up.

items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: Controller: stick, D-pad and held buttons
items.do: Move with the left stick, then with the D-pad. Hold Down for two seconds in a long list. Try a detached Joy-Con or Pro Controller if you have one.
items.expect: Stick and D-pad do the same thing. Holding repeats smoothly and never skips or sticks.

items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: RetroArch launch and quit (R04, evidence only)
items.do: Launch Red from PokeBank NX, then quit RetroArch. Note where you land and any error code. Copy sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX/runtime/last-launch.txt and any new file in sdmc:/atmosphere/crash_reports/.
items.expect: Not fixed in this build. Comment: where you landed, the error code, how you start PokeBank NX (Homebrew Menu / Album / forwarder), and attach last-launch.txt.

items.section: 1. Things only a Switch can show
items.name: An exported copy loads in the emulator
items.where: Edit one item amount → + Review → Export Copy
items.do: Copy the exported save over a COPY of your emulator save (never the original) and start the game in the emulator.
items.expect: The game loads the exported save and shows your change. Your original save is unchanged (same size and date).

items.section: 2. New fixes to confirm on the Switch
items.name: Legacy Storage: Save bank changes? can be answered
items.do: Keep the cursor on the LEFT (game save) side. Tap the bank box name on the right and rename it. Press B. Then press Down and A (Discard changes).
items.expect: 'Save bank changes?' appears and your answer is taken: you leave Legacy Storage. No Pokémon Actions or Empty Slot menu opens on top of the question.

items.section: 2. New fixes to confirm on the Switch
items.name: Profile B cannot see Profile A's backups
items.game: Any game assigned on Profile A
items.where: Profile A: game card → + → Backups → Create backup now
items.do: Switch to Profile B. On the same card press A (chooser), then + (Backups). Then press X (Recovery files).
items.expect: Profile B's Backups and Recovery files do not list Profile A's backup. Back on Profile A, the backup is still listed.

items.section: 2. New fixes to confirm on the Switch
items.name: A file named for the other version is refused
items.do: Pick a save file whose name says the sibling version (for Red: a file named '... Blue Version ...').
items.expect: Refused: 'the file is named as a Pokemon Blue save; choose it from that game's card'. A file with a neutral name (for example save1.srm) can still be assigned.

items.section: 2. New fixes to confirm on the Switch
items.name: Gen V type badges
items.where: Edit a Ninjask, a Charizard and a Gengar
items.do: Look at the type badges under the portrait.
items.expect: Ninjask Bug/Flying, Charizard Fire/Flying, Gengar Ghost/Poison.

items.name: Send the diagnostics
items.where: Settings → Enable Debug Logging (ON), then repeat the failing step
items.do: Copy sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX/logs/debug_*.log and list the files in sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX/config (names and sizes).
items.expect: The log has an 'Assignment storage: ...' line and a line naming the failing step. Attach both. Never delete the config files.
